mechanism: Asymmetric Thresholds: {{state}} change from A→B requires crossing threshold T_up. {{state}} change from B→A requires crossing lower threshold T_down. Gap between thresholds prevents oscillation near boundary. Thresholds fixed or adaptive. It uses a {{dampen}} effect on state transitions, requiring the signal to cross distinct upper and lower thresholds to switch modes.
failure_modes: Stuck {{state}}: the band is wide enough that the signal never reaches `lower_threshold` again.
Chatter: the band is narrow enough that noise alone crosses both thresholds.
invariants: The gap between them is at most `max_gap`.
A→B needs `upper_threshold` crossed; B→A needs `lower_threshold` crossed.

parameters.name: upper_threshold
parameters.description: Level the signal must exceed to switch from A to B.

parameters.name: lower_threshold
parameters.description: Level the signal must fall below to switch back from B to A.

parameters.name: max_gap
parameters.description: Widest permitted band between the thresholds, so the system can still return.
